description: $5,000 for a Gaston County public high school graduate at a UNC System school ($2,000 for NC community college).
eligibility_text: Current Gaston County public high school graduate and Gaston County resident for one year; accredited NC college, university, or community college. Criteria: financial need, character, academic achievement.
